body.query: SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.status = 0 AND c.retry < 3 ORDER BY c._ts DESC, c.priority DESC OFFSET 0 LIMIT 50
SELECT VALUE c.location FROM c WHERE c.state = "SnapshotsCompleted" AND c.retry < 3 GROUP BY c.location
SELECT * FROM c WHERE c.state = 'Discovered' AND c.retry < 3 OFFSET 0 LIMIT 50

[format('SELECT c.subscriptionId, c.location, c.resourceGroup, c.resourceId, c.id, c.userId, c.name, c.osType, c.scanTypes, c._ts, c.ttl, c.privateIpAddress, c.privateIpv6Address, c.host, c.arch, c.retry, c.snapshots, c.discoveryTaskId, c.type FROM c WHERE c.state = "SnapshotsCompleted" AND c.retry < 3 OFFSET 0 LIMIT @{{mul(int(''{0}''), int(''{1}''))}}', parameters('scannersPerLocation'), parameters('locationConcurrency'))]
SELECT VALUE c.data FROM c WHERE c.type = "image"
SELECT VALUE c.id FROM c WHERE c.id in ("@{join(variables('VMIds'),'","')}") AND (c.state != "SnapshotsCompleted" OR c.retry = 3)
